mapper.select: SELECT id, deck_id, new_cards_per_day, target_retention, review_load_profile, duplicate_side_a_enabled, duplicate_side_b_enabled, updated_at FROM pw_deck_settings WHERE deck_id = #{deckId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pw_deck_settings SET new_cards_per_day = #{newCardsPerDay}, target_retention = #{targetRetention}, review_load_profile = #{reviewLoadProfile}, duplicate_side_a_enabled = #{duplicateSideAEnabled}, duplicate_side_b_enabled = #{duplicateSideBEnabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE deck_id = #{deckId}
